state.objective: Complete the accepted aggregate/command/reactor design. Report semantic risk signals per source file; probabilities are advisory, and code/test evidence decides findings. Blocked items are recorded locally and other files continue. No new GitHub issues.
state.missing_context: Other contracts, authorizers, and tests may be outside this excerpt. Do not invent their absence.

authority_gap.instructions: Does this file contain a concrete authority, tenant/program isolation, or source-proof binding defect? Judge its actual responsibility. Do not require aggregates to repeat trusted handler authorization or queries to own mutation policy. Missing helper context alone is not evidence of a defect.

invariant_gap.instructions: Does this file contain a concrete domain invariant or aggregate boundary defect, such as independently mutable children sharing authority without a required atomic invariant, or a live foreign read deciding authoritative state? A bounded immutable manifest or read-only projection is not by itself a defect.

recovery_gap.instructions: Does this file contain a concrete idempotency, replay, optimistic concurrency, interruption, cancellation, or unavailable-dependency recovery defect? Read-only queries do not require mutation replay receipts. Account for the supplied shared helpers.

incomplete_path.instructions: Does this implementation expose or execute unfinished behavior, such as a throwing stub, a missing required receiver, an admitted effect with no durable recovery, or a placeholder result? Explicitly deferred and unregistered paths are blockers to track, not silently implemented behavior.
